name: Bumper Block
description: A bumper block that can move in different patterns and starts at a specified position.

fields.name: Movement Type
fields.description: Defines the movement pattern of the bumper block.

0.name: Spins in place
0.description: The bumper block spins in place.

1.name: Direction
1.description: The bumper block moves in the direction specified by Direction.

2.name: Small circle, Clockwise
2.description: The bumper block moves in a small circular pattern.

3.name: Small circle, Counterclockwise
3.description: The bumper block moves in a circular pattern.

4.name: Big circle, Clockwise
4.description: The bumper block moves in a large circular pattern.

fields.name: Direction / Start Position
fields.description: For Movement Type 1, determines the movement direction. For Movement Types 2–5, determines the initial position within the circle.

fields.name: Increased Movement Speed
fields.description: Increases the bumper block's movement speed.
